title: AvailabilityEnvelope
description: Capability report: what each declared region can serve today and the model provenance behind it. A region with no data anywhere is reported as status no_data with an empty dates list — it is never claimed as available (RULE 7: verified, not guessed). Checkpoint/grid provenance, when present, comes from the same demo-cache manifest that feeds fallback_demo, so availability and the served payloads can never disagree.

model.description: Model identity this build serves (an honest statement, never a realtime claim).

dates.description: ISO dates the current stack can serve for this region (live model-service dates, then demo-cache fallback). Empty when status is no_data; never fabricated.

depths.description: Canonical 15 standard depths in meters, in canonical order. Empty when no_data.

variables.description: The 7 canonical input channels in canonical order (config/variables.yaml). Empty when no_data.

grid.description: Grid shape of the served tensors (from the demo-cache manifest coordinates/grid). null when unknown or no_data.

checkpoint.description: Model checkpoint the served data was built with (from the demo-cache manifest). null when no_data or the manifest is absent.
